steps.say: Three planet gears ride on a carrier between a sun gear and a fixed ring gear.
Input: the brass sun gear (24 teeth) turns.
Each planet (18 teeth) meshes with the sun and rolls inside the fixed ring (60 teeth).
Output: the carrier turns 24 / (24 + 60) = 2/7 of a turn per sun turn, in the same direction.
Exploded along the shaft axis: base, ring, sun, planets and carrier.
